lines: Sometimes, we feel helpless or think, “I can’t do it.”
One good way to escape these feelings is to spend time with people who have already solved the same problem.
This is one of the great powers of self-help groups.
When feeling stuck, we use too much energy on negative thoughts.
That’s why it is hard to think positive thoughts.
On the other hand, people in a good mood have strong positive energy.
Just being around them can be helpful.
In some self-help groups, this is called “hanging out with the winners.”
When we are with positive people, we can share some of their good energy and feel better.
It’s like their good energy wakes up the happy thoughts that were sleeping inside us.
